metaDescription: CPT 99454 explained: the RPM device supply code and its 16-day data rule, plus the newer 2 to 15 day option. Documentation, limits and 2026 rate.
summary: The monthly RPM device-supply code. It requires that the device transmitted readings on at least 16 days in a 30-day period.
time: At least 16 days of transmitted readings in 30 days
performer: Device supplied and data transmitted; no staff time threshold
requirements: A device that automatically transmits or records readings
A data log showing the days with readings
Consent and a practitioner order already on file
pitfalls: Billing with fewer than 16 data days when no alternative code applies
Billing two devices without checking the current supply rules
conflicts: Not reported together with the newer 2 to 15 day supply code 99445 for the same period.

faqs.question: What if a patient has fewer than 16 days of readings?
faqs.answer: A newer 2026 code, 99445, covers 2 to 15 days of data. Your billing lead should confirm which code applies for each patient.

faqs.question: Does Zenith supply the devices?
faqs.answer: Device arrangements vary by practice. Zenith staff review the readings; we confirm the device setup with you during scoping.
